{{Quote|The Malastare system includes three gas giants. Name the remaining planets that have more than one moon.''"<br />"''Malastare and... Cogalle!|A [[Computer/Legends|computer console]] and a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]]|<ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>}}
The '''Malastare system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and seven other planets.
